authority_rule: Canonical semantics, source rights, recovery lineage, leases, and DBR acceptance remain with existing verified source-of-truth owners.

separation_of_concerns.FileSpace: Object identity, scoped filespace family, provenance and relationships
separation_of_concerns.DataSpace: Qualified type-aware structured datasets and projections after FileSpace admission
separation_of_concerns.UniSpace: Context-generated interface and task-driven projection over the same object identities
separation_of_concerns.CCC: Capability and owner-agent descriptor catalogue, not content storage
separation_of_concerns.LOAD: Alexandria content/knowledge lookup and hydration planning; not an executor or independent parent
separation_of_concerns.LightSpeed: Existing Z-floor interaction, rendering and controlled workflow runtime
separation_of_concerns.Smith: Existing singleton execution consumer and signed lease gate, no replacement queue

projection.geometry_preview: triangle and 3 vertex circles radius=0.5*edge, schematic only
projection.input_evidence: caller-provided plans never authenticate source or rights

staged_acceptance: review bounded source-only facet generator and tests
bind to host-authenticated view object and LOAD outputs
validate renderer registration under original LightSpeed shell
verify Smith singleton signed lease and LS GO readback
conduct host-local reversible H1/H2 then H3 acceptance with source, rights, DBR proofs
mint only through established native CGX governance and signed promotion
expand GeoSpatial/first-person and distributed API adapters only after independent qualified evidence
